description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/varcoeff_face_flux_laplacian_lev driven by problems/heat_column_varcoeff_faceflux_forced.esm (interface coefficient K = 1 + z, prescribed upward interface flux F = 0.3 exp(z), matching forcing). The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). The manufactured solution exp(-t) cos(pi z) is exact for the continuous PDE. F is nonzero at both domain faces and curved, so the face closures (-F[1], -F[NLEV+1]) and the interior F difference all contribute: the L2 errors at t=0.1 are the combined second-order spatial error of the K and F parts on the stretched column, falling as O(dz^2) (a dropped or sign-flipped face term leaves an O(1) error, a shifted interior F index a first-order one).
